pages.title: Panspermia
pages.text: $(thing)Panspermia$()$(br2)Life carried between worlds - and between universes. Unlocks panspermia seeds and the omnicellular genome.

$(thing)Insight$(): 450$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Abiogenesis, The Multiverse, The Island of Stability.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 Spark of Life.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Spores ride inside a rock between worlds for time t. Radiation at dose rate R is attenuated by the rock (absorption coefficient μ, depth x), and a spore dies only when all m of its sensitive targets are hit, each target surviving a dose D with probability exp(−D/D0). Write the surviving fraction after the journey.
